recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞的細胞質充滿橙紅色顆粒，包括雙葉核的成熟嗜酸性球及圓核的嗜酸性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes），比例明顯升高，符合嗜酸性球增多。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors throughout the field
Cells with abundant orange-red refractile granules; mature forms with bilobed nuclei
Numerous eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei
Admixed neutrophils, lymphocytes and scattered erythroid precursors
No obvious increase in blasts at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a marked increase in eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature bilobed forms with abundant orange-red granules. Neutrophilic and erythroid elements are present, and no overt increase in blasts is evident at this magnification. Findings indicate marrow eosinophilia; further evaluation for reactive versus clonal causes is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar maturing eosinophils; clinical history and exclusion of clonal markers are needed.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Often accompanied by increased mast cells or fibrosis and identified by FISH/molecular testing rather than eosinophil morphology.
Shows increased blasts and abnormal eosinophil precursors with large dark purple-basophilic granules.
CML has a left-shifted granulocytic expansion with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes, with BCR::ABL1 detected.
